entities.summary: Nissan Slomiansky is an Israeli politician. He served as a member of the Knesset for the National Religious Party between 1996 and 1999, and again from 2003-2009, and was re-elected again in 2013. He is a member of the Jewish Home party. Nissan Slomiansky was a scientists & inventors from Ramat Gan (b. 1946-01-10, Ramat Gan). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
